15                God of our weary years, God of our 

16   silent tears, Thou who has brought us thus far 

17   along the way.  God of us all, we thank You and 

18   we honor You for this day, a day we have not 

19   seen before, a day we will not see again.

 3                Now, God, help us, in the words of 

 4   Isaiah, to learn to do right, to seek justice, 

 5   to defend the oppressed, to take up the calls of 

 6   the fatherless and to plead the case of the 

 7   widow.  

 8                Help us, in the words of the writer 

 9   of Proverbs, to speak up for those who cannot 

10   speak for themselves, for the rights of all who 

11   are destitute.  Help us to speak up and judge 

12   fairly, to defend the rights of the poor and the 

13   needy.  

14                We pray that where there is 

15   violence, there would be peace; where there is 

16   injustice, there would be righteousness; where 

17   there is suffering, there would be comfort; and 

18   where there is hate, there would be Your love.
